name: Westin Lima Hotel & Convention Center
positioning: The Westin Lima Hotel & Convention Center: a high-rise hotel in Lima's San Isidro financial district, with city-view rooms, a large Heavenly Spa and a convention center
best_for: Business travelers and event attendees who want a San Isidro base
Guests who want a city hotel with a full spa and heated indoor pool

facts.text: The hotel is in Lima's San Isidro financial and shopping district, minutes from restaurants, galleries and parks.
Rooms have Westin Heavenly Beds with crisp sheets and down pillows.
The Heavenly Spa has whirlpool suites and a full-service salon.
The spa is designed in a soft palette of white and green, accented by natural woods.
The spa's Shiatsu Corner offers a 25-minute lesson in traditional Japanese massage.
The heated pool is on the second floor.
The pool area has blue tile and indoor trees.
The convention center can host up to 1,600 people and has 19 spaces for meetings, events and weddings.
Nearby Parque el Olivar has quiet paths among centuries-old olive trees.
The fitness studio has TechnoGym strength and resistance machines.

highlights.text: Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of downtown.
The Westin Club lounge is on the 29th floor, with views over the city of Lima.
The Heavenly Spa by Westin has a heated pool and a thermal circuit.
The Presidential Suite, on the 30th floor, is decorated with wooden details, Peruvian textiles and colorful art.
Alphonse is a speakeasy inspired by Prohibition and Al Capone, serving classic cocktails in vintage glassware with jazz, bossa nova and blues.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the San Isidro financial district; the Miraflores district and the Historic Center of Lima are 15 minutes away.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
Pets are limited to one dog per room under 18 kilograms, for an extra fee.
